run_findings.control26_nonregression: Strict zero-residual-executor, zero-optional-monthly-quota, zero-incremental-cost acceptance remains authoritative; control25 relaxation is not imported.
run_findings.openhands_r6_revision: Prior R6 marker candidate is refuted as apply-ready because recovery public-field assignments can autosave intermediate HEAD state and generation-clean later pending markers before the whole chain is committed; this is a candidate bug, not an upstream OpenHands bug.
run_findings.openhands_r7_shape: Two-phase recovery validates the complete marker/event chain without public state mutation, commits one final base snapshot, then cleans old-generation markers; source-equivalent model PASS 11/11.
run_findings.mcp_v220_boundary: Official C# SDK v2.2.0 WithTasks durably creates a unique task, captures current `next`, then schedules volatile Task.Run. After process loss the durable task store has no supported public existing-task/full-ordinary-pipeline restart entrypoint in the exact surfaces examined.
run_findings.mcp_negative_paths: Direct McpServerTool.InvokeAsync is primitive invocation and does not itself rerun ordinary CallToolFilters/current policy; a fresh normal task-backed request reaches CreateTaskAsync again and creates a new unique task.
run_findings.mcp_required_seam: Safe stock redrive would need replayable request/intent + durable existing-task claim/generation + a supported entrypoint that skips only task creation while rebuilding the full current ordinary CallTool policy/filter pipeline. External effects still require effect-side idempotency/fencing.
run_findings.phase1_boundary: All research/model/evidence persistence in this run was Chat-native with zero optional hosted-compute quota and zero incremental monetary cost. Missing upstream/restart capabilities remain unresolved children rather than handoffs.
